description: Preserve human force-rank ordinals through migration. feature.json has `position` (within-parent index 0-5) and `phase` (string), with no initiative/nesting type. SmartMemory's docs/ROADMAP.md carries 336 ordinals / ~170 distinct labels encoding a hand-maintained force-rank that exists in NO other artifact (roadmap-graph.html has no ordinal field; FEATURES.md is unordered). Dropping them breaks inbound references, not merely sort order. A flat `position` carries total order but cannot express sub-ranking under a parent (`19a`–`19v`), post-hoc insertion (`9b'''''`, `25a2`) or cluster tags (`3o-C3`). Minimum viable: a preserved `legacyOrdinal` string field. Source of record: /Users/ruze/reg/my/SmartMemory/smart-memory-docs/docs/features/ROADMAP-MIGRATE-1/design.md.
